snippet.title: From The Dark | Devlog #2 | Exploring The Labyrinths
snippet.description:
JOIN THE DISCORD ► https://discord.com/invite/qFJCGb9atv
GAMEJOLT ► https://gamejolt.com/games/fromthedark/927837

This is the second full-length devlog in a series that covers a voxel-based dungeon game I'm creating called From The Dark. It's centered around a primary mechanic: being blind. The player can use various items to improve their sight, and fight their way through dungeons full of mythical creatures out to hunt them.

In this video, I'll discuss a few new items and enemies I've created, some bosses, some dungeon decorations, NPCs, a main menu, saving/loading, and a tutorial.

This might be the last (or second to last) devlog I upload. The development loop is growing less into "here's some new stuff I'm learning!" and more into "here's more items I made!" since the major parts left to do are just items and enemies. There's not much to discuss there (hence why I breezed past it in this video), and gets stale for videos, especially when I'm trying to avoid talking about more unique items (namely the staffs). The next video I upload will likely be a trailer for the early access, but that's still a few months away.

Like I said in the video, I'll still try to post on the community tab and maybe even more short-form videos, but those would be less focused on "here's something cool I created" and more of "here's something funny that happened still related to the game."
